Agentic AI: A Complete Framework

Five nested circles, from AI & machine learning at the core, through deep learning, generative AI and AI agents, to agentic AI that automates whole processes, plus two dashed outer bands on the right: our prediction of the next wave and of what reaching AGI would still need. Each sticky note is one capability. Press ▶ to watch the circles grow, pick a circle to light up its notes, or tap any note.

Tap a note

Each wave over time

A few landmark moments for each circle, oldest first. Dates are public release or publication dates; the picks are ours. The last two waves have not happened, so they show signals we read as early hints: our reading, not a forecast with dates.
